This small plot is only a quarter hectare, so I will not waste much cash on it. I have my bigger fields to worry about for the main grain. On this one I will put some manure from my cattle since I have it at home, and use the seed I saved from last year. I cannot afford a full bag of DAP for such a small piece — maybe I will sprinkle a little urea if I have some left over from the bigger plots, but not much. My wife and children will help me weed it, and I will not hire anyone for this small piece.
